children: Information technology stocks remain sensitive to shifts in corporate technology spending, AI investment, semiconductor demand and broader expectations for the technology cycle.

While large-cap technology companies have benefited from strong demand for AI infrastructure and digital services, smaller technology and communications-equipment businesses can face different pressures, including uneven enterprise spending, competitive markets and the need for sustained investment in new products and platforms.
Against this backdrop, a screen of information technology stocks identifies five companies with the longest-running Sell or Strong Sell Quant Ratings.

The group includes companies from IT consulting, communications equipment, and electronic equipment and instruments, highlighting several areas of the technology sector where quantitative signals have remained weak over an extended period.
leads the list, having maintained a Strong Sell Quant Rating for 66 consecutive days. Ribbon Communications Inc.
follows with 52 consecutive days, while ADTRAN Holdings, Inc.
has held its Strong Sell rating for 47 days. Powerfleet, Inc.
round out the list with 43 and 38 consecutive days, respectively.

Four of the five companies carry Strong Sell ratings, while Evolv Technologies Holdings carries a Sell rating. The companies operate across different parts of the technology ecosystem, ranging from communications infrastructure and IT services to electronic equipment and technology solutions.

Seeking Alpha's Quant Ratings system grades stocks on their relative performance on key quantitative metrics. It hones in on stocks with the strongest combination of value, growth, profitability, EPS revisions and price momentum relative to their sector peers.
